units.source_text: 斋宫与六条妃子将入宫告辞。

en.t: The Saigu and the Rokujo Consort were about to enter the palace to take their leave.

units.source_text: 源氏大将也想进宫去看看两人的模样。

en.t: General Genji also wanted to go into the palace and see how the two of them looked.

units.source_text: 但念自身乃被弃之人，亲去送别，很不体面，便打消了这念头，只是茫茫然地沉思冥想而已。

en.t: But thinking that he himself was the one who had been cast aside, and that it would be unseemly to go in person to see them off, he abandoned the idea and merely sank into vague, bewildered brooding.

units.source_text: 他看看斋宫的答诗，觉得很像大人口吻，不禁微笑。

en.t: He looked at the Saigu's reply poem, felt that it sounded very grown-up, and could not help smiling.

units.source_text: 想道：“她年方十四，照这年龄看来，这人是很风流的。”

en.t: He thought, She is only fourteen, but for someone of that age, she is remarkably refined and romantic.
He could not help being moved by her.

units.source_text: 原来源氏这个人有一种癖性：

en.t: As it happened, Genji had one particular weakness:

units.source_text: 凡异乎寻常而难于办到之事，他越是念念不忘。

en.t: the more unusual and difficult something was to attain, the more he kept thinking about it.

units.source_text: 他想：“她幼年时候，我本来随时可以看到，却终于没有见过，实甚可惜。

en.t: He thought, When she was a child, I could have seen her at any time, yet in the end I never did; it is truly a great pity.

units.source_text: 但世事变化无定，将来必有和她相见的机会。”

en.t: But worldly affairs are ever changing and uncertain, and someday there will surely be a chance to meet her.
